title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DaRon Bland (ankle) active for Week 10
items.desc: DaRon Bland (ankle) is active for Week 10 for the Dallas Cowboys against the San Francisco 49ers Sunday.
items.impact: Bland will take the field after carrying a questionable designation into the weekend, joining Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) in suiting up for a Dallas secondary that will look to slow down a prolific 49ers offense Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) active for Week 10
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) is active for Week 10 for the Dallas Cowboys against the San Francisco 49ers according to Joe Hoyt.
items.impact: Porter Jr. will suit up after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation, boosting a Dallas secondary tasked with slowing down a dominant 49ers offense Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: George Pickens (hamstring) active for Week 10
items.desc: George Pickens (hamstring) is officially active for Week 10 for the Dallas Cowboys against the San Francisco 49ers according to Joe Hoyt.
items.impact: Pickens is good to go after passing through pregame tests without any issues, boosting a Dallas passing attack that will be without TE1 Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) against the 49ers Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) inactive for Week 10
items.desc: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) is officially inactive for Week 10 for the Dallas Cowboys against the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Ferguson will sit out after being unable to practice throughout the week, leaving quarterback Dak Prescott without a key intermediate pass-catching option. Brevyn Spann-Ford, James Mitchell, and Luke Schoonmaker will consume the snaps at tight end against the 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dre Greenlaw (knee) active for Week 10
items.desc: Dre Greenlaw (knee) is active for Week 10 for the San Francisco 49ers against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Greenlaw is good to go after not suffering any issues during pregame activities, boosting a San Francisco defense that will look to disrupt quarterback Dak Prescott and the Dallas passing attack Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Trent Williams (shoulder) active for Week 10
items.desc: Trent Williams (shoulder) is active for Week 10 for the San Francisco 49ers against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Williams will take the field after clearing through pregame tests without any issues, fortifying a San Francisco offensive line that will look to impose its will on an inconsistent Dallas defense Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Leonard Williams (stinger) inactive for Week 10
items.desc: Leonard Williams (stinger) is inactive for Week 10 for the Seattle Seahawks against the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Williams will not suit up after being unable to take the practice field to end the week, leaving the Seattle front seven without a key interior option against the Raiders Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Charles Cross (ankle) inactive for Week 10
items.desc: Charles Cross (ankle) is inactive for Week 10 for the Seattle Seahawks against the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Cross joins guard Quenton Nelson (knee) out of the lineup Sunday, leaving the Seattle offensive line shorthanded against the Raiders.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Quenton Nelson (knee) inactive for Week 10
items.desc: Quenton Nelson (knee) is inactive for Week 10 for the Seattle Seahawks against the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Nelson will sit out after being unable to practice throughout the week, leaving the Seattle offensive line undermanned against the Raiders Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ladd McConkey (back) ruled out Monday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (back) has been ruled out for Monday night's contest between the Los Angeles Chargers and Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: McConkey will not travel with the team for the Monday night road matchup in Baltimore, with Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris in line for increased targets as part of a dismal Chargers passing attack for head coach Jim Harbaugh against the Ravens Monday night.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Geno Smith being evaluated for a concussion
items.desc: Jets QB Geno Smith is currently being evaluated for a concussion.
items.impact: Smith was hit hard ending the second quarter. Cade Klubnik is currently in at quarterback for the Jets.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Davis Allen (oblique) officially active for Week 10
items.desc: Rams TE Davis Allen (oblique) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with Arizona.
items.impact: Allen was considered questionable to play after being limited in practice for most of the week. Fantasy managers should expect Allen to play behind Tyler Higbee and Colby Parkinson against the Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Aidan Hutchinson (knee) out for season
items.desc: Aidan Hutchinson (knee) will miss the remainder of the season for the Detroit Lions according to Tom Pelissero.
items.impact: Hutchinson suffered a significant knee injury after landing awkwardly on his right leg celebrating his first-quarter sack of New England quarterback Drake Maye. The star pass-rusher's loss deals a significant blow to a Lions front seven that will look for others to fill the void on the defensive line moving forward.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Travis Kelce (ankle) heads to locker room Sunday
items.desc: Travis Kelce (ankle) is headed to the locker room for the Kansas City Chiefs according to Mike Garafolo.
items.impact: Kelce limped off the field in the first quarter after being tackled, hauling in his only target for 23 yards prior to exiting. Noah Gray will take over the TE1 role as long as Kelce remains sidelined.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: A.J. Brown (hamstring) questionable to return Sunday
items.desc: A.J. Brown (hamstring) is questionable to return for the New England Patriots Sunday.
items.impact: Brown exits after catching just two of his six targets for 27 yards in a disastrous game for the New England offense as a whole. The wideout may remain sidelined with the Patriots trailing 28-3 beginning the fourth quarter.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (knee) officially active for Week 10
items.desc: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (knee) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with the Bills.
items.impact: Mitchell was a late add to the injury report this week but is cleared to play. Mitchell, Omar Cooper Jr., and Garrett Wilson are all active for the Jets.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) officially active for Week 10
items.desc: Jets WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with the Bills.
items.impact: Cooper was able to practice in full Friday, but was considered questionable to play Sunday. Cooper and Garrett Wilson are both active and will provide the Geno Smith with his two top targets.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Garrett Wilson (concussion) officially active for Week 10
items.desc: Jets WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup for the Bills.
items.impact: Wilson was listed as questionable to play but has cleared concussion protocol in time to suit up against Buffalo. Wilson will likely lead the Jets' passing attack, with Omar Cooper Jr. and Adonai Mitchell also seeing time alongside the Jets' WR1.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) officially active for Week 10
items.desc: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (knee) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with the Jaguars.
items.impact: Spears was listed as questionable, but was able to close out the week with a full practice session. Tony Pollard will likely continue to see the bulk of the carries out of the Titans' backfield.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) officially active for Week 10
items.desc: Saints RB Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with the Panthers.
items.impact: Etienne was activated from injured reserve and is expected to lead the Saints' backfield. Alvin Kamara will likely see the bulk of his playing time on passing downs against the Panthers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) officially inactive for Week 10
items.desc: Dolphins WR Chris Bell (knee) is officially inactive for a Week 10 matchup with the Colts.
items.impact: Bell was listed as doubtful to play on Sunday as he continues to deal with a knee injury. WR Kevin Coleman should see an increase in playing time in Bell's absence.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Denzel Boston (toe) officially active for Week 10
items.desc: Browns WR Denzel Boston (toe) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with Houston.
items.impact: Boston was able to return to practice Friday and has been cleared to suit up against the Texans. Deshaun Watson will have one of his top pass catchers against a solid Houston defense.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jordan Addison (thumb) inactive for Week 10
items.desc: Jordan Addison (thumb) is officially inactive for Week 10 for the Minnesota Vikings against the Green Bay Packers according to Tom Pelissero.
items.impact: Addison will be sidelined after suffering a thumb injury in practice Friday, leaving the Minnesota passing attack without their WR2. Justin Jefferson is line for increased targets on top of his WR1 status against the Packers Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Drake Maye (ankle) ruled out
items.desc: The Patriots have ruled out QB Drake Maye for the remainder of the game with an ankle injury.
items.impact: Maye was injured early on a sack by Aidan Hutchinson. He will finish the game with completions on 3-of-4 pass attempts for 48 yards and one rush for 11 yards. Tommy DeVito will quarterback the Patriots for the remainder of the game.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) is expected to play Sunday for the Houston Texans according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Anderson Jr. will test the injured ankle during pregame activities for head coach DeMeco Ryans, and barring any setbacks is poised to take the field and boost a Houston starting five that will look to disrupt an inconsistent Browns offense Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sione Vaki (ankle) active for Week 10
items.desc: Sione Vaki (ankle) is active for Week 10 for the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Vaki will suit up after not suffering any issues during pregame warmups, offering head coach Dan Campbell a stable complementary option behind superstar RB1 Jahmyr Gibbs against the Patriots Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) active for Week 10
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is officially active for Week 10 for the New England Patriots against the Detroit Lions according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Stevenson will take the field after clearing through pregame tests on his knee, boosting a New England backfield missing TreVeyon Henderson (illness) and should receive the majority of backfield touches against the Lions Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) active for Week 10
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) is officially active for Week 10 for the Detroit Lions against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: St. Brown is good to go after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation for head coach Dan Campbell, boosting an explosive Detroit offensive attack as a reliable WR1 option against the Patriots in Germany Sunday.
